description: Two inputs and two outputs scaled and offset by one shared pair of knobs, with CV over both, in 2HP

params.text: Scales both inputs, -1x fully counter-clockwise through 0x in the centre to +1x fully clockwise, and further under the menu's scale range
Attenuates and inverts the scale CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Offsets both signals, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and with nothing patched in this knob alone sets the output voltage
Attenuates and inverts the offset CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%

inputs.text: One of the two signals to be scaled and offset; an empty jack is read as 0V, leaving the offset knob alone to set the matching output
Moves the scaling; 5V here covers half the knob's travel at full trim, and the total is held inside the chosen scale range
Adds its own voltage to the offset at full trim, a volt of input giving a volt more offset

outputs.text: Carries that input scaled and offset, with as many channels as that input has

menu: Set offset (semitone steps) — sets the offset knob to a whole number of semitones between -11 and +11, for transposing a 1V per octave signal
Scale-range: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x — widens what the scale knobs cover, 1x meaning -100% to +100%; a light beside the Scale label is dark at 1x, green at 2x, yellow at 5x and red at 10x
Scale-mode: Exp, Linear, Log — bends the response of the scale knobs; the small light beside the Scale label is dark for Linear, green for Exp and red for Log
Order: Scale->Offset, Offset->Scale — chooses whether the input is scaled and then offset, or offset and then scaled; the blue light beside the Offset label is lit for the second
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±1V.
